checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals store-listing-optimization, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 'store-listing-optimization' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The listing covers title, subtitle, description, and the keyword field across App Store and Google Play.
checks.rule: Body produces title, subtitle, description, and the App Store keyword field, and addresses both App Store and Google Play.

checks.description: Each field is built within its store's character limit.
checks.rule: Body states each field's character limit (App Store title and subtitle about 30, keyword field about 100, Google Play short description about 80) and builds within it.

checks.description: Every field is Arabic-first with English on its own terms, and routes through the copy gates.
checks.rule: Body writes each field Arabic-first with English on its own terms and routes to copywriter-ar and the English copywriter for arabic-copy-qa and english-copy-qa.

checks.description: Each field maps to the keyword targets it serves, so the listing is provably built on research.
checks.rule: Body maps each field to the priority keyword targets from aso-keyword-research.

checks.description: The App Store keyword field encodes Apple's indexing mechanics: no indexed stop words, no cross-field repeats, singular-or-plural and cross-field combinations exploited.
checks.rule: Body and template state the keyword field spends no characters on Apple-indexed stop words (for example 'app' or 'the' and their Arabic equivalents), repeats no word across the title, subtitle, and keyword field, includes only one of a singular or plural form, and relies on Apple combining single words across fields into search phrases.

checks.description: The Google Play full description aims for a primary-keyword density near 2 to 3 percent with no stuffing.
checks.rule: Body and template state the Google Play full description carries ranking weight, leads with the priority targets naturally, and aims for a primary-keyword density near 2 to 3 percent with no keyword stuffing.

checks.description: Per-CPP keyword sets are mapped to the segment each Custom Product Page serves, follow the keyword-field mechanics, and are a gated publish.
checks.rule: Body states each Custom Product Page can carry its own assigned keyword set mapped to the segment it serves, following the same keyword-field mechanics, and that per-CPP keywords are a gated publish.

checks.description: No field implies accreditation or invents a Skill Path title, content lineup, instructor name, offer, or price.
checks.rule: Body forbids implying a certificate is accredited and forbids inventing Skill Path titles, content lineup, instructor names, offers, and prices, instructing stop-and-ask when absent.

checks.description: Publishing a listing change is a gated action behind the human gate.
checks.rule: Body states publishing a listing change is a gated action behind the human gate and silence is not approval.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no U+2014 em dash, no U+0640 tatweel, and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
